name: Albugnano

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Piedmont DOC for red and rosé wine led by Nebbiolo, at least 85%, with Freisa, Barbera and Bonarda allowed up to 15%. It comes from four communes including Albugnano and Pino d'Asti.
